public_profile.policy: Intersection of existing native public binding with effectively public Java/C# source declarations,plus reviewed necessary native transport. Original engine semantics;no managed serializer/parser/math emulation. Public source-only constructs lacking C++ counterpart explicitly excluded.
public_profile.kept_cpp_type_registrations: All original69 native class registrations retained internally for Embind shared_ptr/polymorphic transport;not exported as public JS constructors unless listed.

lexer_stdio.scope: Actual original C stdio globals stdin/stdout/stderr and null;no fclose or arbitrary FILE adoption.

native_license_constructor.scope: Original empty native default constructor;no per-instance licensing state,all18existingstaticAPI entries retained. No license confirmation on consumer behalf.

native_string_stream.scope: Original new_StringStream factory/sharedptr. D1 minimal native std::stringstream payload str getter/setter withlosslessbytevalues,not entire std::iostream API.

expression_definition_pack.transport: D1 original native List constructor, preserving leading nullable definition slots; variadic/List native8 equivalence verified

std_string_factories.result: owned Uint8Array byte value;not a native pointer-identity handle

native_locale.scope: Original std::locale native value payload of SystemUtils.classicLocale;C++default/name/copy andname only. Mutable nullable shared native field;noJSlocale implementation ornative std::locale::global change.
